label: ORACLE_LOOKAHEAD
use: Upper bound and attribution only (R5); never a strategy or a candidate source beyond TRAIN.
population: lifecycle frame; universe per cell (quoted price >= 5 USD where stated; FUND: PIT panel rows with market cap >= 300 Mio USD)
survivorship: TRAIN/VALIDATION populations contain no delisting (all series end >= 2023); the oracle can only pick survivors.

gaps.note: Per-interval values are gross buy-and-hold returns over each decision interval (identical forward-return definition as the oracle). Selection = EW picks minus EW population; weighting = actual weights minus EW picks; timing/cash = effect of holding cash (market filter, exits, unfilled slots). Funded CAGRs are net of base costs.
